description:
AgentView is the complete per-agent state the server owns and renders to. A
 snapshot carries the whole view; patches carry entity-level deltas.

^(session_id)$.description:
The id of the Subscribe stream this view is delivered on, set on the stream's
 first frame (the snapshot). Two windows of one agent signed in with the same
 token each get their own. Echo it as `Command.session_id` on every Send so
 the command reaches this window's session, and pass it as
 `SubscribeRequest.resume_session_id` when this window subscribes again.
 Empty on a view that belongs to no stream (GetState).
